from z3 import *

num_golfers = 35
num_weeks = 5
num_groups = 7
group_size = 5

# Variables: x[w][p] in 0..6
x = [[Int(f"x_{w}_{p}") for p in range(num_golfers)] for w in range(num_weeks)]

s = Solver()

# Domain constraints
for w in range(num_weeks):
    for p in range(num_golfers):
        s.add(x[w][p] >= 0, x[w][p] < num_groups)

# Constraint 1: Each week, each group has exactly 5 golfers
for w in range(num_weeks):
    for g in range(num_groups):
        s.add(PbEq([(x[w][p] == g, 1) for p in range(num_golfers)], group_size))

# Constraint 2: Each pair of golfers meets at most once
pairs = list(itertools.combinations(range(num_golfers), 2))
print(f"Number of pairs: {len(pairs)}")

for p1, p2 in pairs:
    s.add(PbLe([(x[w][p1] == x[w][p2], 1) for w in range(num_weeks)], 1))

print("Constraints added. Solving...")
start = time.time()
result = s.check()
elapsed = time.time() - start
print(f"Result: {result}, time: {elapsed:.2f}s")
